description_en: Associates a MACsec key with a dedicated Express Connect circuit port. MACsec uses dedicated encryption chips (such as NICs or switches) to implement low-latency encryption and decryption, directly encrypting physical links (such as optical fibers or Ethernet) to cover all traffic from the sender to the receiver
description_zh: 支持在独享物理专线端口上面关联MacSec密钥，通过专用加密芯片（如 NIC 或交换机）实现低延迟加密/解密，从而直接对物理链路（如光纤、以太网）进行加密，覆盖从发送方到接收方的全部流量
kebab_example: aliyun vpc associate-mac-sec-key --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --physical-connection-id pc-bp1hp0wr072f60000 --cipher-suite GCM-AES-128 --ckn 0123456789ABCDEF0123456789ABCDEF --cak 0123456789ABCDEF0123456789ABCDEF --region cn-hangzhou
name: AssociateMacSecKey

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the Express Connect circuit.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/448570.html operation to query region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
物理专线所在的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/448570.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Express Connect circuit. The Express Connect circuit must be a dedicated circuit that has completed payment, supports MACsec, and is in the Enabled state. You can call DescribePhysicalConnections to query the current status and device capabilities
parameters.help_zh: 物理专线ID。物理专线必须是已完成付费、设备支持MACsec的独享物理专线，并处于Enabled状态。可通过DescribePhysicalConnections查询当前状态和设备能力
parameters.name: physical_connection_id

parameters.help_en:
The encryption algorithm type. Valid values:

GCM-AES-128

GCM-AES-XPN-128

GCM-AES-256

GCM-AES-XPN-256
parameters.help_zh:
加密算法类型，取值范围：

GCM-AES-128

GCM-AES-XPN-128

GCM-AES-256

GCM-AES-XPN-256
parameters.name: cipher_suite

parameters.help_en: The key name. Only hexadecimal characters are supported. Lowercase characters are automatically transformed to uppercase. When the encryption algorithm type is GCM-AES-128 or GCM-AES-XPN-128, the length must be 32 hexadecimal characters. When the encryption algorithm type is GCM-AES-256 or GCM-AES-XPN-256, the length must be 64 hexadecimal characters
parameters.help_zh: 密钥名称，只支持十六进制字符，小写会自动转换为大写，当加密算法类型是GCM-AES-128或者GCM-AES-XPN-128时，长度要求为32个十六进制字符，当加密算法类型是GCM-AES-256或者GCM-AES-XPN-256时，长度要求为64个十六进制字符
parameters.name: ckn

parameters.help_en: The passphrase. Only hexadecimal characters are supported. Lowercase characters are automatically transformed to uppercase. When the encryption algorithm type is GCM-AES-128 or GCM-AES-XPN-128, the length must be 32 hexadecimal characters. When the encryption algorithm type is GCM-AES-256 or GCM-AES-XPN-256, the length must be 64 hexadecimal characters
parameters.help_zh: 密钥密码，只支持十六进制字符，小写会自动转换为大写，当加密算法类型是GCM-AES-128或者GCM-AES-XPN-128时，长度要求为32个十六进制字符，当加密算法类型是GCM-AES-256或者GCM-AES-XPN-256时，长度要求为64个十六进制字符
parameters.name: cak
